text: 金价失守4270美元，黄金消费者“舍得出手”了 加息预期打满、美债利率冲顶，黄金短期定价逻辑被重构导致金价回调。但市场普遍认为利空出尽后有望触底回升，同时金饰消费市场呈现“量降价升”的分化趋势。
text_en: Gold price falls below $4,270; gold consumers are now "willing to buy" — rate hike expectations fully priced in and US Treasury yields hitting a peak have reshaped gold's short-term pricing logic, leading to a pullback. But the market widely believes that after the bad news is fully digested, gold prices are expected to bottom out and rebound, while the gold jewelry consumer market shows a diverging trend of "lower volume, higher price."
